verdict.rationale: Adyen documents issuing physical cards through the API by creating a paymentInstrument of type physical, and markets the cards as "fully customizable." That covers the core act of ordering a physical card via API without a direct manufacturer relationship. Nothing in the evidence describes how card art customization works or covers bulk ordering, shipping options, or delivery tracking. Missing for 10: documented custom card art/design workflow, bulk card ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking/delivery webhooks, explicit statement that Adyen manages card manufacturing/fulfillment, independent corroboration.
